videos.title: I built 10 web apps... with 10 different languages
videos.description: Explore the landscape of full-stack web development by comparing 10 popular frameworks across 10 different programming languages. This deep dive evaluates the developer experience of building an application with Ruby on Rails, Django, Laravel, Next.js, Spring, ASP.NET, Phoenix…

videos.title: Realtime Chat App in Rust!
videos.description: This video demonstrates building a real-time chat application using the Rust programming language and the Rocket web framework. It covers the core concepts and implementation details for developing interactive network applications.
